courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering structural analysis and design, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, water resources, environmental engineering, surveying and construction management. Programmes pair lecture teaching with materials, hydraulics and surveying laboratories, site visits and a final-year design project. Graduates work in construction, infrastructure, consultancy and public works, or continue to a master's specialisation.

universities.name: Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology
universities.summary: Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology (AMCET) is a private, self-financing engineering college founded in 2012 at Arappakkam on the Chennai-Bengaluru highway near Vellore, Tamil Nadu, run by the R.T. Educational Trust. It is not a university: it is a non-autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which awards its degrees. AICTE approves eight B.E./B.Tech branches, an MBA and an MCA for 2026-27.
universities.campusLifestyle: AMCET's campus covers about 25 acres at Arappakkam on NH-46, with three academic blocks and a 500-seat auditorium. Its central library covers 866 sq m with the Koha library system, DELNET, NPTEL and National Digital Library access, and subscribes to 89 national and 73 international journals. Laboratories are listed for ECE, EEE, Mechanical, CSE, AI and Data Science and Civil. Sports include an indoor stadium, a gym and outdoor cricket, football, volleyball and basketball.
universities.cityProfile: AMCET is on NH-46, the Chennai-Bengaluru highway, at Arappakkam in Walaja taluk, Ranipet district, Tamil Nadu 632517. AICTE lists the address under Vellore district, from which Ranipet was carved out. DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet gives Katpadi as the nearest railway station, 10 to 12 km away, and Ranipet as the district headquarters, 12 km away. Anna University's college code is 5135.
universities.practicalExposure: AMCET is not autonomous, so it follows Anna University's curricula and regulations: the university sets the syllabus, conducts the end-semester exams and awards the degree, and the college runs internal assessment. AICTE makes an internship mandatory for every admitted student. The college's Centre for Training and Placement runs campus drives and records 27 recruiters on its 2024 placement table, among them HCL, Infosys, TCS and Sundaram Fasteners. Offer counts and packages are self-reported.
universities.hostelOverview: AMCET has separate boys' and girls' hostels on campus with four-occupancy rooms, a mess serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, Wi-Fi, a common room and computer room, laundry, RO drinking water and a 24-hour security desk. DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet lists room rent and mess together at about INR 1.08 lakh a year, electricity of INR 2,000 and a caution deposit of INR 5,000. Parents must accompany the student to the warden to take a room.
universities.dietarySupport: AMCET's hostel messes serve vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. Fixed timings are breakfast 7:15 to 8:25 am, lunch 12:30 to 2:00 pm, tea and snacks 4:30 to 5:30 pm and dinner 7:30 to 8:30 pm, followed by a study hour from 8:30 to 10:00 pm. The college also runs a cafeteria. It publishes no menu or provision for specific regional or religious diets, so ask the warden before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: AMCET's AICTE disclosure lists an anti-ragging committee and squad, an internal complaints committee for sexual-harassment complaints, a women grievance cell and an SC/ST committee. The hostels have a 24-hour security desk. TNEA 2026 publishes an anti-ragging phone number for the college (+91 94433 04963).
universities.studentSupport: AMCET runs a Centre for Training and Placement, a higher-education centre, a personality development centre and an entrepreneurship cell with a startup club and Institution's Innovation Council. Grievances go to a students grievance and redressal committee. The college gives annual Academic Excellence awards, branded Mira Merit Scholarship, to students with high Anna University results; amounts are not published.

faq.question: Is Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology autonomous or affiliated to Anna University?
faq.answer: Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology (AMCET) is a non-autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which sets its syllabus and exams and awards its degrees. Anna University lists it in Ranipet district with college code 5135, and DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet gives its autonomous status as No.

faq.question: What is the TNEA code for Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology?
faq.answer: The TNEA counselling code for Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology (AMCET) is 1137. TNEA 2026 lists eight branches under it: Civil (CE), Computer Science (CS), AI and Machine Learning (AM), EEE (EE), ECE (EC), Mechanical (ME), AI and Data Science (AD) and Information Technology (IT).

faq.question: Is Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology AICTE approved?
faq.answer: Yes, AMCET is AICTE approved as a private self-financing institution, permanent ID 1-404537421. Its Extension of Approval for 2026-27, dated 10 April 2026, covers eight B.E./B.Tech branches, an MBA and an MCA, all affiliated to Anna University, Chennai.

faq.question: Is Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology in Vellore or Ranipet?
faq.answer: AMCET is at Arappakkam on NH-46, in Walaja taluk. It was in Vellore district until Ranipet district was formed, so AICTE still prints Vellore while DoTE and the college itself print Ranipet. Katpadi railway station near Vellore is 10 to 12 km away.

faq.question: What is the B.E. fee at Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology?
faq.answer: AMCET does not publish its tuition; a management-quota seat is confirmed by paying 50 per cent of the fee prescribed by AICTE and Anna University, so ask the college. Tamil Nadu's fee committee fixes tuition for self-financing colleges. TNEA 2026 lists an admission fee of INR 1,500, a caution deposit of INR 5,000 and transport at INR 16,000 to 30,000 a year.

faq.question: Does Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology admit international or NRI students?
faq.answer: No, AMCET has no NRI or international-student approval: AICTE's 2026-27 approval marks both as No for every course. TNEA is for Indian nationals; OCI/PIO card holders who are natives of Tamil Nadu may apply unless born abroad after 4 March 2021.

faq.question: How do I get admission to Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology?
faq.answer: Most B.E./B.Tech seats are filled through TNEA: register at tneaonline.org, get a rank from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), and choose code 1137. Management-quota seats (35 per cent) are filled directly by the college on a first-come basis. MBA and MCA seats use TANCET and Tamil Nadu MBA/MCA counselling.

faq.question: Does Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology offer MBA and MCA?
faq.answer: Yes. AICTE approves an MBA with 60 seats, started in 2023, and an MCA with 60 seats, approved as a new course for 2026-27. Admission needs a TANCET 2026 mark sheet and at least 50 per cent in the qualifying degree (45 per cent for Tamil Nadu reserved categories).

faq.question: Does Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology have hostels?
faq.answer: Yes, AMCET has separate boys' and girls' hostels on campus with four-occupancy rooms and a mess serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. TNEA 2026 lists room rent and mess together at about INR 1.08 lakh a year, plus INR 2,000 electricity and a INR 5,000 caution deposit.

faq.question: Is Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology NBA accredited?
faq.answer: No branch is NBA accredited according to DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet. The college's mandatory disclosure cites a NAAC B++ grade but gives no certificate or validity date, so ask the college for the NAAC certificate before relying on it.

admissionsContent.overview: The MCA at Annai Mira College of Engineering and Technology (AMCET) is a two-year, four-semester English-medium degree at Arappakkam near Vellore, awarded by Anna University. 2026 is its first intake. Seats are filled through Tamil Nadu's MCA counselling on TANCET scores and by the college.

eligibility.intro: The Tamil Nadu MCA 2026-27 counselling instructions set these conditions for state-quota seats at AMCET.
items: A pass in B.C.A., B.Sc. (Computer Science), B.Sc. (IT), B.E. (CSE), B.Tech. (IT) or an equivalent degree, or any graduation degree with Mathematics at Class 12 or degree level
At least 50 per cent in the qualifying degree (45 per cent for Tamil Nadu BC, BCM, MBC/DNC, SC, SCA and ST candidates)
10+2+3/4/5, 10 + 3-year diploma + degree, lateral-entry diploma + degree and AMIE with two years' experience are accepted patterns
TANCET 2026 (MCA) mark sheet issued by Anna University
Degrees taken by distance or weekend B.E./B.Tech study, or without Class 10 and 12 or a diploma, are not eligible

applicationSteps: Take TANCET 2026 (MCA), conducted by Anna University, and download the mark sheet
Register online for Tamil Nadu MCA 2026-27 counselling and upload degree, school and community documents
Choose college code 1137 (AMCET) in counselling and confirm the allotment
Report to the college with the allotment order and pay the fees; for a management-quota seat, apply to the college directly through its online PG application

academic: Bachelor's degree certificate and mark sheets for all semesters
Class 10 and Class 12 (or diploma) mark sheets
